tools.name: create_news
tools.title: Create an article
tools.description: Create a news (Article) in the specified space.

summary.description: Optional short summary/abstract shown above the article body. Stored as article metadata — this is NOT the body content.

html_content.description: The article BODY content (markdown/HTML). This is the main content; do not put the summary here.

target_space_id.description: Id of the space to create the article in.

tools.name: publish_news_in_activity_stream
tools.title: Publish an article
tools.description: Posts a news in the activity space of its target space.

tools.name: delete_news
tools.title: Delete an article
tools.description: Delete a news entry by its ID.

tools.name: get_news_list
tools.title: Get articles by space
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of news for a space.

tools.name: search_news
tools.title: Search for articles
tools.description: Search news by a term within a space.

tools.name: get_news_by_id
tools.title: Get an article
tools.description: Get a single news entry by its ID.

tools.name: update_news
tools.title: Update an article
tools.description: Update the title, summary and/or HTML content of an existing news (Article). Only the provided fields are changed. The optional 'language' targets the summary translation to update (defaults to the article's default language).

news_id.description: Id of the article (news) to update.

title.description: New article title. Omit to leave the title unchanged.

summary.description: New short summary/abstract shown above the article body. Stored as article metadata — setting it does NOT change the article body. Omit to leave the summary unchanged.

html_content.description: New article BODY content (markdown/HTML). Use this ONLY to change the main body; never put a summary here. Omit to leave the body unchanged.

language.description: Optional language code targeting the summary translation to update; defaults to the article's default language.

tools.name: set_news_illustration
tools.title: Set an article cover image
tools.description: Set the cover (illustration) image of a news (Article) from exactly one of: a public image URL, a base64-encoded image, or a reference to a file already attached to a platform object (attachment_object_type + attachment_object_id).

news_id.description: Id of the article (news) whose cover/illustration image to set.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to use as the cover. Provide exactly ONE image source (image_url, image_base64, or attachment_object_type+attachment_object_id).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes to use as the cover. Provide exactly ONE image source.

attachment_object_type.description: Type of an existing platform object whose already-attached image to reuse as the cover (paired with attachment_object_id).

attachment_object_id.description: Id of the existing platform object whose already-attached image to reuse as the cover (paired with attachment_object_type).

alt_text.description: Alternative text describing the cover image, for accessibility.

language.description: Optional language code; defaults to the article's default language.

tools.name: remove_news_illustration
tools.title: Remove an article cover image
tools.description: Remove the cover (illustration) image of a news (Article).
